meta.description: The Jumanly match score explained simply: the criteria, the weights, what the AI never uses, and your right to a human review.

matchingPage.title: How matching works
matchingPage.lead: On Jumanly, AI recommends and people decide. Here is, in plain language, how we calculate the match between a talent and an offer.

s1.title: 1. A score from 0 to 100
s1.body: For each offer, we compare the recruiter's needs with your profile. The result is a score from 0 to 100. The higher it is, the more your profile fits what the offer asks for.

s2.title: 2. Eight criteria, and only those
s2.body: The score adds up eight criteria related to the job:

list.8: how close your profile is to the job description.

s3.title: 3. Weights chosen by the recruiter
s3.body: Each criterion counts for a share of the score. The recruiter can give more weight to what really matters for the job. These weights are shown in the score explanation.
s3.example: Fictional example · Junior data analyst, Baobab Fintech

s4.title: 4. Four easy-to-read levels
s4.note: A low score is not a rejection. You can always apply, for free.

s5.title: 5. A “Why?” on every score
s5.body: Every score comes with an explanation: the criteria met, those partly met, the missing skills, and the Jumanly courses that can close the gap.
s5.example: Fictional example: Grâce Mbuyi, Pro talent in Kinshasa.
s5.imageAlt: Example explanation of an 87% score, with the criteria met, the missing skills and a course to close the gap

s6.title: 6. What we never use
s6.body: This information is never taken into account in the score, or in any suggestion:
s6.plan: Your Jumanly plan is not taken into account either: a Free profile is hired just like a subscriber.

s7.title: 7. AI rejects no one
s7.body: Matching ranks and explains. It never rules out an application. If an offer sets knockout criteria (for example a degree required by law), they are shown on the offer; a candidate who does not meet them is flagged to the recruiter, never rejected automatically. Every decision is made by a person.

s8.title: 8. You can challenge it
s8.body: If your score looks wrong, tap “Report an error” under the explanation. Someone from the Jumanly team checks the calculation and replies by e-mail.

s9.title: 9. You stay in control
s9.body: You can turn off the match calculation in your settings. You can still apply; the recruiter will see your application without a score.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Does paying for a plan improve my score?
faq.a1: No. The plan is not part of the calculation. Plans give access to tools to progress (courses, AI coach), which can help you strengthen your profile.
faq.q2: How can I improve my score?
faq.a2: Complete your profile, state the level of your skills and take the courses suggested in the “Why?”. Jumanly certificates make your skills verifiable.
faq.q3: Does the recruiter see my score?
faq.a3: Yes, with the same explanation as you. It helps them prioritize, not decide for you.
faq.q4: Who can contact me through matching?
faq.a4: Only the recruiters of the offers you apply to, or those whose introduction request you accept if your profile is visible in the talent pool.

seo.title: Privacy policy · Jumanly
seo.description: How Jumanly processes your personal data, uses AI in an explainable way and respects your visibility choices.

summary.title: The essentials in a few lines
summary.item1: You choose who sees your profile.
summary.item2: AI makes explained suggestions. It never makes a hiring decision.
summary.item3: Partner institutions only see aggregated statistics, never your CVs or your messages without your consent.
summary.item4: We do not sell your data.
summary.item5: You can export your data and delete your account at any time.

controller.title: 1. Data controller
controller.text: The data controller is The Growth Lab, [company name], [address], [country], publisher of Jumanly. For any question about your data: infojumanly@gmail.com. [Data protection officer or contact person: to be appointed, contact by e-mail only].

data.title: 2. Data we process
data.account: Account data: last name, first name, e-mail address, encrypted password, country, city, language, profile chosen at sign-up, consents.
data.profile: Professional profile data: title, summary, photo (optional), experience, education, skills and levels, languages, availability, preferences (contract, location, remote work, desired salary), visibility setting.
data.documents: Documents: CVs imported or created, letters, bio, portfolio, files sent to a recruiter.
data.learning: Learning data: courses taken, progress, quiz and assessment results, certificates.
data.career: Preparation data: answers to the career assessment, progress plan, interview simulations (text and, for voice simulations, audio recording and transcript).
data.applications: Application data: offers viewed and saved, applications, stages, recruiters' notes and assessments, decision history.
data.messages: Communications: messages, invitations, document requests, appointments.
data.org: Recruiter and organization data: professional identity, position, organization, offers posted, members, roles, company verification information.
data.billing: Payment data: plan, history, amounts, Mobile Money operator and number used (masked), last four digits of the card, billing information. Full card details and Mobile Money PINs are processed by our payment providers and are never stored by Jumanly.
data.technical: Technical data: connection logs, IP address, device and browser type, cookies (see the cookie policy).
data.ai: AI usage data: requests sent to the assistants, suggestions produced, suggestions applied or ignored, quota consumption.
data.sensitive: We do not ask you for sensitive data (origin, religion, opinions, health, etc.). Avoid including it in your CV or your messages. [Possible processing of disability-related data for inclusion purposes: to be studied with the lawyer]

purposes.title: 3. Why we process it
purposes.service: Providing the service: creating and managing your account, your courses, your documents, your applications and your conversations. Basis: performance of the contract (terms and conditions).
purposes.matching: Bringing talents and offers together: calculating a match, suggesting offers, courses or profiles, with an explanation. Basis: performance of the contract [and legitimate interest, to be confirmed].
purposes.recruitment: Allowing recruiters to manage their hiring while respecting your visibility choices. Basis: performance of the contract.
purposes.billing: Managing subscriptions, payments, invoices and sponsored licenses. Basis: performance of the contract and legal accounting obligations.
purposes.security: Ensuring security, preventing fraud, fake recruiters and mass data extraction. Basis: legitimate interest.
purposes.improvement: Improving the platform using usage statistics. Basis: legitimate interest, or consent for audience measurement cookies.
purposes.partners: Producing aggregated reports for the institutions that fund licenses. Basis: [legitimate interest or performance of the contract with the partner, to be confirmed].
purposes.marketing: Sending you tips and news by e-mail, if you have agreed to it. Basis: consent, which can be withdrawn at any time.
purposes.legal: Meeting our legal obligations and responding to requests from authorized authorities.

ai.title: 4. Artificial intelligence and explainable matching
ai.principle: At Jumanly, AI recommends and people decide. AI tools help you write, correct, prepare and spot opportunities. The matching engine helps recruiters spot profiles. None of these recommendations ever automatically becomes a decision.
ai.noAutomatedDecision: No decision producing legal effects or significantly affecting you is made solely on the basis of automated processing. No application is accepted or rejected automatically by AI: a recruiter always decides.
ai.explanation: Each suggestion comes with a “Why?” link showing what it is based on: skills present or missing, experience, criteria set by the recruiter, preferences you have stated.
ai.criteria: The match score relies only on professional criteria: skills and their level, experience, education, languages, location and work preferences, explicit criteria of the offer. It never uses your plan, your photo, your age, your gender or any sensitive data.
ai.rights: At any time, you can ask for an explanation of a suggestion or a score, challenge a score you believe to be inaccurate, and ask for a person to step in. Write to infojumanly@gmail.com, naming the offer or suggestion concerned.
ai.audit: Matching calculations and suggestions are logged so that they can be checked and explained.
ai.providers: Some AI processing is carried out by technical providers acting on our behalf. [Contractual commitment not to use the data to train models: to be checked before publication] [List of AI providers, countries of processing and contractual safeguards to be completed]
ai.free: The simplified career assessment and the general tips of the Free plan rely on fixed rules and content, without calling on AI.

visibility.title: 5. Visibility of your profile
visibility.intro: You choose who can see your profile, and you can change this setting at any time in your settings.
visibility.private: Private: only the recruiters of the offers you apply to see your full profile.
visibility.recruiters: Visible to recruiters: your profile, with your name, appears in the talent pool that subscribed recruiters can browse.
visibility.anonymous: Anonymous: your profile appears in the talent pool without your name or your photo. They are only revealed if you accept an introduction request.
visibility.contact: You must accept an introduction request before any conversation. Recruiters' searches and requests are limited by quotas to prevent mass data extraction.
visibility.application: When you apply, the recruiter of the offer can access your profile, the attached documents and the conversations linked to that application.
visibility.public: Some pages can be made public at your request: a shareable portfolio, the verification link of a certificate.

recipients.title: 6. Who can access your data
recipients.recruiters: Recruiters and companies, within the limits described above and according to the roles assigned within their organization.
recipients.partners: Partner institutions (Jumanly Partners) that fund your license only receive aggregated usage and impact reports: number of licenses activated, courses taken, certificates earned, applications sent, reported hires. They have no access to your CVs, messages or personal data, unless you give explicit and specific consent, which you can withdraw at any time.
recipients.team: The authorized teams of The Growth Lab, for support and moderation. Support has no access to the content of your private messages.
recipients.processors: Our technical subcontractors: hosting [name], e-mail delivery [name], Mobile Money and card payment [names], artificial intelligence [names], audience measurement [name]. They act on our instructions and are bound by confidentiality.
recipients.authorities: Authorities, when the law requires it.
recipients.noSale: We neither sell nor rent your personal data.

transfers.title: 7. Transfers outside your country
transfers.text: Some providers may process data in other countries: [list of countries]. These transfers are governed by [contractual safeguards or applicable mechanisms, to be specified].

retention.title: 8. Retention periods
retention.intro: We keep your data for as long as needed for the purposes described. Proposed periods, to be confirmed:
retention.account: Account and profile: as long as the account is active. Account inactive for [period to be defined]: notice by e-mail, then deletion or anonymization.
retention.applications: Applications and related conversations: [period to be defined] after the offer closes, unless you delete your account before.
retention.recruiterNotes: Recruiters' notes, assessments and decision history: [period to be defined] after the offer closes.
retention.voice: Audio recordings of interview simulations: [period to be defined, as short as possible]; the transcript and feedback remain available in your space.
retention.certificates: Certificates: kept as long as the account exists, so they can be verified.
retention.billing: Invoices and accounting data: [legal period of the country of jurisdiction].
retention.logs: Technical and security logs: [period to be defined].
retention.ai: Audit log of matching and AI suggestions: [period to be defined].
retention.deletion: When you delete your account, your data is deleted or anonymized within [period to be defined], except for data the law requires us to keep.

rights.title: 9. Your rights
rights.list: Depending on the applicable law, you have the following rights: access to your data; rectification; erasure; restriction of processing; objection; portability; withdrawal of your consent at any time; the right not to be subject to a decision based solely on automated processing; the right to obtain an explanation of an AI suggestion and to challenge it; [the right to set instructions for what happens to your data after your death, if applicable].
rights.selfService: Several of these rights can be exercised directly in “Settings”: editing your profile, changing your visibility, exporting your data, deleting your account, managing your e-mail preferences.
rights.howTo: For any other request, write to infojumanly@gmail.com. We may ask you to prove your identity. We reply within [legal period to be specified].
rights.complaint: If you believe your rights are not respected, you can contact the competent data protection authority: [name of the authority of the country of jurisdiction].

security.title: 10. Security
security.text: We protect your data with appropriate technical and organizational measures: encrypted communications, encrypted passwords, role-based access control, logging, backups. In the event of a data breach that puts you at risk, we inform you as provided for by law.

minors.title: 11. Minors
minors.text: Jumanly is reserved for people aged at least [minimum age to be defined]. [Access conditions for minors, for example for internships, to be defined with the lawyer]

changes.title: 12. Changes
changes.text: We may change this policy. In the event of a significant change, we will let you know by e-mail or in the app before it takes effect.

contact.title: 13. Contact
contact.text: Personal data and general questions: infojumanly@gmail.com. Professionals and partners: assistant@jumanly.io.

seo.title: Terms of use and sale · Jumanly
seo.description: Rules for using the Jumanly platform and the conditions of subscriptions, payments and sponsored licenses.

terms.title: Terms of use and sale
terms.intro: These terms govern the use of the Jumanly platform, published by The Growth Lab ([company name], [address], [country]), and subscriptions to its paid plans. By creating an account, you accept them.

definitions.title: 1. Definitions
definitions.text: “Platform”: the jumanly.io website and its services. “User”: anyone with an account. “Talent”: a user who uses the learning, career and application services. “Recruiter”: a user who posts offers and manages hiring, alone or within an organization. “Organization”: a company or body with a shared recruiter space. “Partner”: an institution that funds licenses for beneficiaries. “Plan”: a free or paid package defining the features and quotas available. “Quota”: the volume of use of a feature per period.

services.title: 2. Services offered
services.text: Jumanly brings together five services: Learn (courses), Career (career tools), Jobs (offers and applications), Hire (recruitment management) and Connect (messages, invitations, appointments), supported by artificial intelligence tools. The features available depend on your plan, described on the Pricing page.

account.title: 3. Account
account.text: You must provide accurate information and keep it up to date. Your account is personal; you are responsible for keeping your credentials confidential. A single account can belong to one or more organizations, with the roles they assign to you. Minimum age: [to be defined].

free.title: 4. Free applications
free.text: Creating an account and a profile, and applying, are free and unlimited, whatever the plan. No paid option is a condition for applying. Profiles on the free plan can be shortlisted and hired just like paying subscribers.

ai.title: 5. Artificial intelligence
ai.text: AI suggestions (corrections, recommendations, match scores) are provided as help. They come with an explanation and can be applied or ignored. They are not a hiring decision: only recruiters decide. AI can make mistakes; you remain responsible for the content you publish. You can ask for an explanation or challenge a suggestion at infojumanly@gmail.com.

talentRules.title: 6. Talents' commitments
talentRules.text: You agree to publish truthful information about your background, not to impersonate anyone and not to send falsified documents.

recruiterRules.title: 7. Commitments of recruiters and organizations
recruiterRules.text: You agree to post real, lawful and non-discriminatory offers; never to ask a candidate for money to apply or be hired; to use candidates' data only for the hiring concerned; to respect their visibility choices; not to extract, copy or resell talent pool data; and to comply with applicable labor and data protection law. The holder of the organization account is responsible for the actions of its members.

partnerRules.title: 8. Partners
partnerRules.text: Partners access aggregated reports. They have no access to beneficiaries' CVs, messages or personal data without their explicit consent. The specific conditions of each partnership are set by contract.

prohibited.title: 9. Prohibited uses
prohibited.text: The following are prohibited in particular: unlawful, hateful, discriminatory or misleading content; fraudulent offers; harassment; sending unsolicited messages in bulk; automated data extraction (bots, scraping); bypassing quotas or security measures; reselling access.

moderation.title: 10. Moderation, suspension and reporting
moderation.text: Any user can report an offer or a message. The Growth Lab may remove content, suspend or close an account in the event of a breach, after informing the user except in an emergency or where required by law. The user can challenge this by e-mail at infojumanly@gmail.com.

content.title: 11. Content and intellectual property
content.text: You remain the owner of the content you publish. You grant The Growth Lab a non-exclusive license, limited to what is needed for the service to work (hosting, display to authorized recipients, processing by AI tools at your request). The courses, the Jumanly brand and software remain the property of their owners; courses are for personal use only.

certificates.title: 12. Certificates
certificates.text: Certificates issued by Jumanly Learn certify the successful completion of a course on the platform. They are not a degree or a state certification, unless stated otherwise.

availability.title: 13. Availability and liability
availability.text: The Growth Lab strives to provide continuous access to the service, without guaranteeing permanent availability. Jumanly is not a party to employment relationships between talents and employers and does not guarantee getting a job or being hired. [Limitations of liability to be drafted by the lawyer]

data.title: 14. Personal data
data.text: The processing of your data is described in the privacy policy.

closure.title: 15. Closing your account
closure.text: You can delete your account at any time from your settings. A current paid plan is not refunded merely because the account is deleted, unless otherwise provided in article 22 [to be defined].

plans.title: 16. Plans and prices
plans.text: The plans, their features, their quotas and their prices are described on the Pricing page, which forms part of these terms. Prices are in US dollars (USD), [including or excluding taxes: to be specified according to applicable tax rules]. The amount may be converted into your local currency by the operator or the bank at payment time; any conversion or operator fees [are paid by the user / are included: to be defined]. The Company Premium plan and Partners licenses are subject to a specific quote and contract.

quotas.title: 17. Quotas
quotas.text: Some features are subject to quotas per period, visible in your dashboard. The period is one month from the start date of the subscription. You are notified at 80% and then at 100%. Once a quota is reached, the feature is temporarily limited until renewal, unless you buy an option or change plans. Quotas may change; any reduction applies to the next period, after notice. Quotas never apply to applying.

payment.title: 18. Payment
payment.text: Payment is made by Mobile Money or bank card, through approved payment providers. Subscriptions are monthly and payable in advance. With Mobile Money, the subscription is prepaid for one period and is not renewed automatically. [Automatic renewal by card: to be defined with the provider] A receipt and an invoice are made available after each payment.

renewal.title: 19. Renewal, grace period and return to the free plan
renewal.text: We remind you of the due date 7 days and 3 days before, and on the day itself. Without renewal, your plan stays active for a grace period of {graceDays} days. At the end of this period, your account automatically returns to the free plan of its family (Free or RH Free). Your data is kept; only the paid features are paused. For an organization, offers and members beyond the limits of the free plan are paused, not deleted.

change.text: Upgrade: it is immediate. The time left on the previous plan is credited according to the following rule: [pro rata rule to be defined]. Downgrade: it takes effect at the end of the period already paid, without a refund of the current period [to be confirmed].

[Conditions for termination by The Growth Lab and suspension for breach: to be defined] [Termination conditions of Company Premium and Partners contracts: according to the contract]

refund.text: [Existence and length of a right of withdrawal under applicable law: to be defined] [Refund cases (double payment, payment debited without activation, prolonged unavailability of the service) and terms: to be defined] If a payment is debited without your plan being activated, write to infojumanly@gmail.com with the payment reference: we will sort it out.

seo.title: Cookie policy · Jumanly
seo.description: Which cookies Jumanly uses, why, and how to manage your choices.

cookiesPolicy.title: Cookie policy

what.title: 1. What is a cookie?
what.text: A cookie is a small file placed on your device when you visit a website. It lets the site remember information, such as your sign-in or your preferences.

necessary.title: Necessary cookies

seo.title: About Jumanly · Vision, mission and values
seo.description: Jumanly connects learning, careers and recruitment to bring talents and employers together. A platform developed by The Growth Lab.

hero.title: Connecting skills with opportunities
hero.text: Jumanly is a digital platform that brings together professional training, career development, discovering opportunities and managing recruitment in a single ecosystem.
hero.imageAlt: Talents and recruiters connected by the Jumanly platform

vision.title: Our vision
vision.text: To build a leading African platform that makes it easier to develop skills, progress professionally and bring talents and employers together.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.text: To support people as they build their professional path and help organizations identify, assess and hire the skills they need more effectively.

positioning.title: Where three worlds meet
positioning.intro: Our ambition is not to offer several services on one website, but to connect them into one continuous professional experience.

careertech.title: CareerTech
careertech.text: Career support, building a professional profile and getting ready for opportunities.

hrtech.title: HRTech
hrtech.text: Finding talent, automating some HR tasks and managing recruitment.

continuity.title: A continuous experience
continuity.text: A talent can learn, enrich their profile, improve their application and apply. An employer can find that profile, review their qualifications, talk with the candidate and organize the hiring. Everything happens in one place.

access.title: Accessibility
access.text: Everyone should be able to build a professional presence, even without the means to pay. That is why the account, the profile and applications are free.

fairness.title: Fairness
fairness.text: Free profiles are shortlisted and hired just like paying subscribers. The plan gives no priority in applications.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.text: Every AI suggestion explains its “Why?”. Quotas are visible and prices are clearly displayed.

humanDecision.title: Human decision
humanDecision.text: AI recommends, people decide. No recommendation ever automatically becomes a hiring decision.

privacy.title: Respect for privacy
privacy.text: You choose how visible your profile is. Institutional partners only receive aggregated data.

growthlab.title: An initiative of The Growth Lab
growthlab.text: Jumanly is developed and run by The Growth Lab, which leads the product strategy, the organization of content, the commercial policy, partnership management and the supervision of the platform.

faq.title: Billing questions
faq.q1: Which payment methods do you accept?
faq.a1: Mobile Money and bank card. The available operators depend on your country and are shown at payment time.
faq.a2: So that the price is the same in every country. The amount is converted into your currency at payment time, at the rate of the operator or the bank.
faq.a3: With Mobile Money, the subscription is prepaid for one month and does not renew on its own. We remind you of the due date in advance, and you renew in one step. [Automatic renewal by card: to be confirmed with the payment provider]
faq.q4: What happens if I don't renew in time?
faq.a4: You get a grace period of a few days during which your plan stays active. After that, you automatically go back to the free plan, without losing your data.
faq.q5: Can I change plans in the middle of the month?
faq.a5: Yes. An upgrade applies immediately, and the time left on your current plan is taken into account. A downgrade takes effect at the end of the period already paid.
faq.q6: Can I cancel at any time?
faq.a6: Yes. Your plan stays active until the end of the paid period, then you go back to the free plan. Your data is kept.
faq.a7: Refund rules are set out in our terms of sale. [Refund rules to be defined]
faq.q8: What happens when a quota is reached?
faq.a8: The feature concerned is paused until your period renews. You can wait, or move to a higher plan. You are notified at 80% and then at 100% of each quota.
faq.q9: Do I have to pay to apply?
faq.a9: No, never. No paid option is a condition for applying.
faq.a10: Yes. Each payment comes with a receipt sent by e-mail and an invoice you can download in “My subscription”. For an organization, you can enter the company name and billing address.
faq.q11: An institution funds my plan. What happens if I already have a subscription?
faq.a11: If the license offered is higher than your plan, it applies right away. If your current plan is higher, the license is put on hold.
faq.q12: Do you offer quarterly or annual plans?
faq.a12: Not at the moment. Subscriptions are monthly. Other durations may be offered later.

seo.title: Frequently asked questions · Jumanly
seo.description: Free access, plans, payment by Mobile Money and card, artificial intelligence, privacy, recruitment and partner licenses: all the answers about Jumanly.

hero.title: Frequently asked questions
hero.text: Can't find your answer? Write to us and we will reply by e-mail.

general.a1: Jumanly is a platform that brings together professional training, career development, job offers and recruitment management. It is for talents, human resources professionals and organizations.
general.a2: Jumanly is a platform developed and run by The Growth Lab, which leads its strategy, content, commercial policy and supervision.
general.q3: Can I use Jumanly on my phone?
general.a3: Yes. The site is designed for phones first and also works on tablets and computers, from your browser.
general.q4: Can I be both a talent and a recruiter?
general.a4: Yes. You have a personal account and you can also be a member of one or more organizations. A switcher lets you move from your personal space to your organization's space.

talents.q1: Do I have to pay to apply?
talents.a1: No. Applications are free and unlimited for everyone, whatever your plan, even if your AI assistance quotas are used up.
talents.a2: No. Free profiles can be shortlisted and hired just like paying subscribers. Your plan gives you no priority and no disadvantage in applications.
talents.q3: How do I follow my applications?
talents.a3: In your space, the “My applications” section shows the stage of each application, its history and the recruiter's messages.
talents.q4: What does the free plan include?
talents.a4: Your account and professional profile, a simplified career assessment, browsing offers, free applications and their tracking, 5 CV templates, a selection of free courses, general preparation tips and messages linked to applications.

learn.q1: Do the courses give a certificate?
learn.a1: Yes. When you finish a course and its assessments, you get a certificate you can download as a PDF, with a public verification link. It can appear on your profile.
learn.a2: A selection of courses is open to everyone. In the catalog, each course shows whether it is free or included in a plan.
learn.q3: Can I try a course before signing up?
learn.a3: Yes. The first lesson of each course can be previewed on its public page.

ai.q1: Does the AI decide who gets hired?
ai.a1: No. AI recommends, people decide. Matching helps recruiters spot profiles, but no application is ever accepted or rejected automatically.
ai.q2: How do I know why the AI suggests something to me?
ai.a2: Every suggestion has a “Why?” link that explains what it is based on: skills, experience, the criteria of the offer. You can apply or ignore each suggestion.
ai.q3: What happens when my AI assistance quota is reached?
ai.a3: The feature concerned is paused until your period renews. You can wait or move to a higher plan. Applying, however, always remains possible.

privacy.a1: You choose between three settings: private (only the recruiters of the offers you apply to see it), visible to recruiters, or anonymous (name and photo hidden until you accept an introduction).
privacy.q2: Can a recruiter contact me if I have not applied?
privacy.a2: Only if your profile is visible in the talent pool. The recruiter then sends you an introduction request, which you are free to accept or decline before any conversation.
privacy.q3: Can I download or delete my data?
privacy.a3: Yes. In your settings, you can export your data and ask for your account to be deleted.

billing.a1: With Mobile Money or a bank card. Prices are shown in USD.
billing.a2: With Mobile Money, the subscription is prepaid for a period. We remind you of the due date 7 days and 3 days before, and on the day itself. Without renewal, you get a short grace period, then you go back to the free plan.
billing.q3: Do I lose my data if I go back to the free plan?
billing.a3: No. Your profile, CVs, certificates and applications are kept. Only the paid features are paused.
billing.a4: Yes, at any time. An upgrade applies immediately. A downgrade takes effect at the end of the period already paid.

recruiters.a1: Yes. RH Free includes a recruiter account, one active offer, receiving applications, simple stage management and messages linked to applications.
recruiters.q2: What is the difference between Jumanly for RH and Jumanly for Companies?
recruiters.a2: The RH plans suit independent recruiters and small teams, up to 3 users. The Company plans add more team members, a verified company profile, team management, permissions and steering reports.
recruiters.q3: Why is talent search limited by quotas?
recruiters.a3: To protect talents. Search and introduction quotas prevent the mass extraction of personal data.
recruiters.q4: How do I get the “Verified company” badge?
recruiters.a4: The verified company profile is included in the Company plans. Our team checks your organization's information before showing the badge.

partners.a1: It is Starter, Pro or Premium access funded by an institution (bank, university, foundation, company, public program) for an agreed period. You have nothing to pay.
partners.q2: How do I activate my license?
partners.a2: With the code or invitation link you received from the institution. Sign in or create your account, then enter your code on the activation page.
partners.q3: Can the institution funding my license see my CV or my messages?
partners.a3: No. It only receives aggregated usage and impact reports, with no CVs, no messages and no personal data, unless you consent to it.
